panel.board_outline_import_policy: Use only panel.outer_ring as the panel exterior; it already stitches exterior-touching routing mouths into one closed contour. Import panel.route_cutouts and boards[].cutouts as closed routed voids. Import all NPTH drills. panel.nominal_outer_ring and boards[].outer_ring are references only. Do not import all_routing_regions as cutouts because some touch the exterior.
panel.tooling_note: 2.0mm outer profile/router; 1.0mm cutter required for separate constellation slots. 0.8mm stars and 0.6mm mousebites are non-plated drills.

constellation.endpoint_policy: Independent per-edge endpoint setbacks; 1.03mm nominal material webs with >=1mm exported-geometry acceptance.

assembly.glue_region: peripheral spacer material only; keep 30mm internal windows clear
assembly.registration: all five octagon centers and faces aligned; no permanent mounting holes
assembly.sagittarius_view: Artwork and local star coordinates are the outside-back view. Mirror across assembly local X when checking through-stack projection onto the core.

color_silkscreen.status: planned; user image import and Gerber review required

manufacturing.appearance_note: Color artwork is a separate manufacturer output, not ordinary white silk or solder-mask color.
manufacturing.routing_order: internal apertures, panel routing and NPTH, retain tabs; manually depanel after assembly
